description: This file defines the class SugarFieldWysiwyg, a custom field handler for a WYSIWYG (rich text editor) in the SuiteCRM application. It extends the base SugarFieldBase class and overrides methods related to rendering detail and edit views, integrating TinyMCE for rich text editing functionality.

classes.name: SugarFieldWysiwyg
classes.description: Custom field class for WYSIWYG editing, integrates TinyMCE in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to disable inline editing on detail view.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to initialize TinyMCE editor with specific configuration and handle exceptions.
